classification_pushback.published_input: Kondo's exhaustive classification of finite-automorphism strong Coble surfaces in characteristic not two

finite_all_branch_compiler.branches: For every numerical boundary frame, enumerate every sequence of input classes which becomes a smooth (-1)-class under the exact blowdown update, ending at P2 or a Hirzebruch surface. Rank drops at every step.
finite_all_branch_compiler.incidence_space: Reverse each sequence as a universal iterated point blow-up; relative Hilbert schemes parameterize one smooth geometrically irreducible curve in every numerical wall class. Impose the marked incidences, h ample, disjoint reduced boundaries summing to -2K, h0(-K)=0, and h0(-2K)=1. This is a finite union of finite-type locally closed stacks over Spec Z[1/2].
finite_all_branch_compiler.name: C_CobVin(P,h)
finite_all_branch_compiler.necessity: On an exact carrier, the strict transform on the original surface of every curve in a minimal-model contraction has negative square; strong-Coble negativity and exact nefness put it among the input facets, so one enumerated branch contains every exact carrier.
finite_all_branch_compiler.termination: There are finitely many frames, finitely many input classes, and at most rank(N) contractions per branch. Hilbert/flattening and saturated-ideal algorithms decide geometric nonemptiness and its constructible characteristic image.

promotion_and_return_theorem.canonical_K3_corollary: The double cover branched along the reconstructed reduced -2K divisor is a smooth K3 with its deck involution. In characteristic three its crystalline period and period-preserving involution exist geometrically; no abstract crystalline Torelli guess is required.
promotion_and_return_theorem.intrinsic_iff: For every (P,h) in D_CobVin and every algebraically closed field of characteristic not two, P has an exact marked strong-Coble full-nef carrier taking h to an ample class if and only if C_CobVin(P,h) has a geometric point over that field.
promotion_and_return_theorem.minus_one_exhaustion: Adjunction gives total boundary incidence two. A hidden (1,1) (-1)-curve gives a hidden effective irreducible CM root. A hidden (2) curve gives the primitive nef isotropic class f=E+B_i/2, hence an ideal extreme ray. Primitivity follows from the Halphen index-at-most-two theorem and the primitive fiber multiplicity vector (2,1) on 2E+B_i. The denominator's complete integral cusp-lift regeneration already lists it.
promotion_and_return_theorem.root_exhaustion: A compiler point makes every numerical CM root an effective irreducible root: a listed (-2) curve is irreducible, while the negative-definite support of 2E+B_i/2+B_j/2 forces a listed two-boundary (-1) root to have no proper effective root below it. Its raw Vinberg certificate makes W(Gamma) finite index in O(CM); hence W(S) is finite index, Aut(S) is finite, and Kondo's Proposition Vinberg2 says Gamma is the complete effective irreducible root set.
promotion_and_return_theorem.same_P: The unique anti-bicanonical boundary, complete root stock, and all single-boundary cusp lifts exhaust every negative curve. Therefore the marked nef cone is literally the oriented input chamber P.

scope.compactness: Every geometric branch is noncompact: pull back a ruling from a minimal Hirzebruch model (or from the penultimate F1 before a P2 model) to obtain a primitive nef isotropic ray. Finite volume is a separate raw Vinberg/cone hypothesis and is never inferred from finite sidedness or from the existence of a cusp.
scope.exact_L4_missing_gate: Find a surface-free P-only subdenominator containing more than a prelisted answer set on which the raw numerical conditions force at least one incidence stack to be nonempty. Without that theorem, Kondo pushback classifies only R_CobVin={P:C_CobVin(P) nonempty}.
